user.title: Connect to the Garmin bridge
user.description: Enter the address of the Garmin bridge and the access token it was started with.

data_description.bridge_url: The address of the bridge, for example the host name or the IP address of the computer that runs it.
data_description.bridge_token: The value of GARMIN_BRIDGE_TOKEN on the bridge.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge. Check the URL and the token.

init.title: Garmin bridge options
init.description: Choose what the watches can see and how notifications are delivered.

data_description.exposed_entities: Leave empty to expose every controllable entity.
data_description.blocked_entities: Entities that are never shown on the watch, even when they are exposed.
data_description.phone_notify_service: The notify service used to mirror messages to the paired phone, for example mobile_app_iphone. The Garmin Connect app then pushes them to the watch.
data_description.create_mirror_switches: Create a switch in Home Assistant for every entity the watch can toggle.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the integration asks the bridge for the watch and entity state.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Queue a notification for the connected Garmin watches.

title.name: Title
title.description: The title shown above the message on the watch.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Buttons the watch shows underneath the message.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity this notification is about.

watch_id.name: Watches
watch_id.description: Limit the notification to these watch ids.

run_command.name: Run command
run_command.description: Run a command through the bridge, the same mechanism the watch uses.

command.name: Command
command.description: toggle, turn_on, turn_off, open, close, set_level, set_value or service.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity the command applies to.

set_exposed_entities.name: Set exposed entities
set_exposed_entities.description: Choose which entities the watches can see and control.

entity_ids.name: Entities
entity_ids.description: The entity ids the watches may control.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Ask the bridge to re-read the Home Assistant states right away.
